axes.name: Reserve attestation present
axes.rubric: Stranger-retrievable CPA report as_of on or after 2026-07-13. Self-reported balances / NAV / process audits are not reserve attestations.

grading_rules.YES: Third-party reserve attestation (Deloitte/PwC/etc.) publicly published with as_of >= 2026-07-13

axes.name: Declared regulatory framework

grading_rules.YES: Governing regime declared and confirmable (MiCA/UCITS/Reg D/BVI/etc.)

axes.name: Represented vs distributed
axes.rubric: RWA.xyz public classification + holder count. RWA API v4 is UNCHECKABLE (401). Flag represented>>distributed (JMWH pattern).

grading_rules.YES: Distribution classification present and not represented>>distributed (JMWH pattern)

axes.name: Named custodian/auditor
axes.rubric: Custodian AND auditor both named. Disclosure presence only, never quality.
